journeys.name: full_project_pipeline_journey
journeys.setup: Compile the existing Python service fixture and load canonical repository registries.
journeys.observable_result: Every locally executable transition succeeds and all unavailable external legs are explicitly typed as blocked rather than verified.
journeys.cleanup: Temporary Git repository and state databases are removed; no remote Jira/GitHub/cloud mutation is performed.

journeys.name: duplicate_and_idempotency
journeys.setup: Create a stable incident identity and repeat the same open operation.
journeys.observable_result: Duplicate delivery does not create duplicate operator work or remote writes.

journeys.name: partial_failure_retry_and_recovery
journeys.setup: Force the first provider unavailable and exercise durable unknown-outcome/worker-loss scenarios.
journeys.observable_result: Safe fallback succeeds; uncertain effects are not blindly retried; autonomous recovery must verify the external condition before resolution.
journeys.cleanup: All temporary state is in-memory or temporary-directory scoped.
